Also need to ensure final answer is within <final_answer> tags, not extra spaces. Provide proper JSON string with double quotes. Also need to ensure no extra tags. Provide:

<thought>...</thought>
<final_answer>{"mapped_rxn": "...", "template_id": 2895}</final_answer>

Make sure the mapped_rxn string is exactly as retrieved. It contains many quotes and brackets; need to escape double quotes inside? The string itself contains no double quotes, only single quotes? It contains brackets and colon etc, but no double quotes. So we can embed directly.

Thus produce final answer.
